narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for a children's news-based picture book series titled '欖仁媽媽全球新聞臺'. It uses the compelling hook of 'microplastics' personified as characters to explain how the book simplifies complex global issues (SDGs) for young readers, encouraging parents to purchase or learn more.
